title: Organic Origins (Hydrocarbons to Amides)
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: The starting point for CHEM 3B organic chemistry: spot, name and draw organic compounds, then explain their properties. Four simple tiles, each with topics students can tick to mix: Spot It (Spot the Group, 1°/2°/3° classification, Med Molecules with 123 real drugs, metabolism intermediates and biomolecules plus nursing, dental, anesthesia and imaging fun facts), Name & Draw (Name It, Draw It, Isomer Sorter; Challenge problems with multi-branched IUPAC names such as isopropyl, sec-butyl, isobutyl and tert-butyl), Properties (Properties, Rank It by boiling point or water solubility using real data), and Test Yourself (60-second Blitz, or Exam Practice with 242 final-exam style questions from Final Boss). Structures in skeletal, one-line condensed, or branched condensed style. Includes hints, step-by-step naming explanations, XP, streaks, badges, and a Dr. Dan CHEM 3B video playlist. Reaction practice lives in Bond Voyage.
